items.title: milind-soni/OpenMausBot
items.summary: OpenMausBot is an open-source Grok Bot alternative that allows you to create your own AI bot team within chat applications. The software comes with virtual machine support that the bots can utilize.

snapshot.description: Open-source Grok Bot alternative with a virtual machine that bots can use. The open-source Grok Bot alternative: your own team of AI bots, in a chat app.

items.title: CopilotKit/OpenBot
items.summary: CopilotKit/OpenBot enables the creation of open-source AI coworkers that can access tools such as browsers and files. This system supports any user interface agent (AG-UI agent) integration with a structure that plans every action before executing it and records it afterward.

snapshot.description: Open-source AI coworkers that each get a computer of their own: a browser, files and tools, with every action decided before it happens and recorded after. Bring any AG-UI agent.

items.title: Donchitos/Claude-Code-Game-Studios
items.summary: Claude-Code-Game-Studios is a project that aims to transform the Claude Code software development tool into a comprehensive game studio. It offers a coordination system that mimics a real studio hierarchy by using 49 AI agents and 72 workflow skills.

snapshot.description: Turn Claude Code into a full game dev studio — 49 AI agents, 72 workflow skills, and a complete coordination system mirroring real studio hierarchy.

items.title: Patrick Stewart has died
items.summary: According to news published by the New York Times, actor Patrick Stewart has passed away. The news of the artist's death received widespread coverage on social platforms.

items.title: We're releasing the weights of Mistral Large 4
items.summary: Mistral AI has released the weights of its large language model, Mistral Large 4, as open source. This move allows developers to run and customize the model on their own infrastructure.

items.title: Binance-hacker-1029 – $5.6B stolen from Binance
items.summary: It is alleged that assets worth 5.6 billion dollars were stolen from the Binance cryptocurrency exchange via a digital wallet named Binance-hacker-1029. These data, shared by the blockchain analysis platform Arkham Intelligence, allow for tracking the activity at the wallet address in question.

items.title: DoorDash to acquire Instacart
items.summary: Food delivery platform DoorDash has announced that it will acquire the grocery delivery service Instacart. With this merger, it is aimed for stores of all sizes to reach a wider customer base by accessing the technological infrastructure used by large online retailers.

snapshot.description: Together, DoorDash and Instacart would help stores of every size reach more customers with the kinds of innovative technology that the biggest online retailers and grocers build for themselves.

items.title: LLM Voice
items.summary: LLM Voice, written by Martin Fowler, addresses the artificiality in texts generated by large language models (LLMs) and the uncanny valley effect this situation creates. The article evaluates the characteristic stylistic issues present in AI-generated content despite its similarity to human language.

snapshot.description: The uncanny valley of LLMs' prose

items.title: LiquidAI/LFM3-1.7B
items.summary: LFM3-1.7B, developed by LiquidAI, is a text-generation model designed for local agents and specialized applications. Based on a new tri-hybrid architecture, this model aims to provide efficient performance with a low parameter count.

snapshot.description: text-generation model. LFM3-1.7B is a text model for local agents and specialized applications, based on our new tri-hybrid architecture.

items.title: Intrinsic Distribution Matching
items.summary: Intrinsic Distribution Matching, shared by Hugging Face, aims to achieve high accuracy with a limited number of steps in text-to-image generation processes. Based on the distribution matching distillation method, this study examines the effects of an explicit moment constraint for the convergence of generated images to the reference distribution.

snapshot.description: One-step and few-step text-to-image generation must accurately render the details specified in the prompt despite limited opportunities for refinement. Distribution matching distillation (DMD) uses score differences to bring the generated distribution closer to a reference distribution. Following prior work, we estimate this difference with internal velocity branches, avoiding a separate fake-score network. items.title: Your Benchmark Is an Empirical Measure Over Difficulty
items.summary: The article shared by Hugging Face defines benchmark tests not just as collections of questions, but as empirical measurement tools based on difficulty levels. This perspective aims to make evaluation processes more systematic by identifying fundamental failure modes such as measurement misalignment and coverage gaps.

snapshot.description: A benchmark is not merely a collection of test questions; it naturally induces an empirical measure over difficulty. In this work, we develop this measure-based view of benchmark evaluation. items.title: A Broader Look into MLLM's Retrieval Heads
items.summary: The article shared by Hugging Face examines the retrieval heads that provide multimodal large language models with the ability to find evidence in long inputs. The study questions the effect of this mechanism across different modes and how it can be used to improve models.

snapshot.description: Locating relevant evidence in long inputs is a core capability of Multimodal Large Language Models. Prior studies attribute this capability to retrieval heads, a sparse set of attention heads that transfer information from the context to the output. However, these analyses are confined to a limited set of modalities and the corresponding models. Moreover, how retrieval heads can be leveraged to enhance the model calls for further exploration. items.title: Co-Design Bench: Multimodal Collaborative Coding Evaluation for Agentic Models
items.summary: Co-Design Bench, shared by Hugging Face, is an evaluation tool that measures the ability of AI coding agents to translate real users' multimodal requests into application changes. Containing 273 tasks across two distinct areas—multimodal editing and repository editing—this benchmark was created using data obtained from real user sessions.

snapshot.description: Evaluating human-AI co-design requires testing whether coding agents can translate real users' multimodal requests into working application revisions. We introduce Co-Design Bench, a reference-free benchmark of 273 tasks curated from 37,463 deduplicated queries across 26,314 real user coding sessions. items.title: AskStream: When and What to Ask Proactively under Uncertainty in Streaming Video Understanding
items.summary: AskStream offers an interactive method that determines when and what an AI should ask in cases of uncertainty during streaming videos. It aims to transform multimodal large language models from passive responders into agents that proactively query for missing information.

snapshot.description: Recent advances in multimodal large language models have increased interest in interaction paradigms for video understanding. The evolution from offline to streaming and proactive interaction has gradually shifted models from passive responders toward more proactive agents that can decide when to answer.
